Three minutes before the truck opens

How to check gear in with Scan Sheet: get the list, tick and scan what's there, flag what's wrong, send it back. Every app picture here is a real screen from the beta, with a made-up sample list.

The steps, in writing

Words in this style are what you see on the screen. Pictures were taken from the 1.35 beta in the iPhone simulator, which has no camera: on a real phone the top of the scan screen is the live camera. The name, email, company and list in the pictures are made up.
